access.assessment: Direct FetchUrl checks returned 200 for terms, robots and the exact property page. Robots allows the public property path and excludes internal APIs. Terms prohibit disruptive-volume scraping. No internal APIs or guessed pagination were used.
access.rights: No review-text redistribution license was found. The community submission license grants rights to MyLivingChoice, not Harbor. Harbor publishes its own short descriptions of what the visible individual accounts report, not copied passages, the site's automated summary, or verified care claims.
access.privacy: Summaries omit author and staff names, ages, diagnoses and other personal medical details.

scopeNote: 224 Google ratings reported; five individual accounts visible. Four have original summaries. One writer identifies as both an employee and a family member, so that account remains a staff link. These unverified, selected reports are not representative.

accounts.summary: A Google reviewer describes a relative's stay and praises staff responsiveness, meal adjustments and rehabilitation support. The reviewer reports that the relative returned home.
A Google reviewer praises staff and therapy during a relative's rehabilitation and help with discharge. The reviewer also says the building needs updating.
A Google reviewer describes a parent's meals and praises the kitchen team's consistency and willingness to accommodate food preferences.
A Google reviewer describes visiting a relative and sharing lunch. The account praises dining service, meal variety and the welcome from kitchen staff.
